title: Compass overlay checklist & contextual empty-state visual pack
creator: Ava Patel
description: Design and deliver a modular set of onboarding UI assets for the Console first-run experience: a progressive checklist overlay (Compass), a set of contextual empty-state illustrations with microcopy, and a screenshot pack for release notes and docs. These assets should be easily consumable by engineering and docs, adapt across small & large viewports, and be accessible (contrast, readable copy).
goals: Reduce time-to-first-success for new orgs by clarifying critical first-run tasks
Provide lightweight, copy-driven empty states that guide users to create their first model route or connect Dedicated capacity
Ship a screenshot and asset pack for docs, release notes, and marketing collateral
acceptance_criteria: Compass overlay: scalable React-friendly components (header, progressive checklist steps, inline tips) with 3 visual density variants (compact / default / expanded)
Empty-state set: 6 contextual illustrations (no-data for projects, models, routes, tokens, usage, alerts) with alternative copy and CTA variants; exported as PNG 2x and SVG
Screenshot pack: 12 annotated screenshots (desktop & tablet) exported with safe zones and copy layers for marketing use
Figma file has clear component tokens, spacing system, and named exports; handoff spec includes token values and CSS variable mapping
Accessibility: text sizes >= 14px for body, color contrast >= 4.5:1 for primary copy, and step focus states documented for keyboard navigation
assets: illustrations: svg/empty_project.svg, svg/empty_route.svg, svg/empty_tokens.svg, svg/empty_usage.svg, svg/empty_models.svg, svg/empty_alerts.svg
screenshots: tablet/empty_states_models_tablet@2x.png - models empty state with CTA
handoff_notes: Engineering: components should accept props for step states (pending/complete/disabled), support reduced-motion, and expose aria-live regions for dynamic step updates. Use token names: --rdw-space-2, --rdw-text-900, --rdw-accent-500. Export annotated screenshots with separate copy layers. QA: verify focus trap behavior when overlay is open and keyboard-accessible progression through steps.
design_decisions: Progressive disclosure: keep primary CTA visible while showing optional tips inline to avoid modal fatigue
Single-source illustrations: SVGs designed to be recolored via CSS tokens so marketing can match themes
Three density variants to support both large orgs and small teams who want compact UI
tradeoffs: Chose inline overlay vs full-screen tour to reduce interruption; tradeoff is limited real-estate for long walkthroughs
SVG recoloring means some illustration detail sacrificed for flexibility
risks: Engineering time required to support density variants and aria-live updates
Edge cases for very small viewports where checklist may need to collapse to a summary
tasks: Create docs screenshot pack & annotated guide for release notes
Sync with ENG for prop contract and token mapping
